summary:
Iteration 13 frontend-only: validated Antidote Dictionnaires/Guides buttons in RichEditor (desktop mock only), tool usage summary card on teacher SessionDetail, and SurveillanceReport PDF generation.

(1) Desktop mock injected via add_init_script with window.monExam.antidotePort=async()=>0: joined HIS301 as 'TEST DictGuide Iter13', passed PreCheck (precheck-ok, forbiddenApps=[]), started exam, typed 'Bonjour monde fantastique', selected word 'monde', clicked exam-rich-editor-antidote-dict-btn → toast 'Antidote (Connectix) n'a pas répondu sur ce poste.' shown. Repeated with 'fantastique' + guide button → same error toast. Editor remained editable (typed ' extra' after errors). Regression: 'Corriger avec Antidote' btn still works and shows both the Connectix error toast and the Ctrl+C+C fallback toast. No pageerror.

(2) Browser without window.monExam mock: joined HIS301 as 'TEST NoMock Iter13'; essay editor shows ONLY exam-rich-editor-antidote-btn; both exam-rich-editor-antidote-dict-btn and exam-rich-editor-antidote-guide-btn are ABSENT. No console errors.

(3) Teacher login (lynchs2757@gmail.com) → Results of HIS301 → selected 'TEST DictGuide Iter13' session → data-testid=tool-usage card is visible with text: 'Antidote — 3 utilisation(s) (dictionnaires ×1, guides ×1, correcteur ×1)'. Selected 'TEST NoMock Iter13' (session with no tool events): tool-usage card is NOT rendered (confirming only-when-usage behaviour).

(4) Clicked export-surveillance-report-btn: 9 `report-tools` blocks were rendered in the hidden DOM container (one per session), html2pdf processed without any page errors or console errors. Verified via inspection of hidden DOM before PDF export completed.
critical_code_review_comments: toolUsage.js: antidote_dict/guide events are counted together as actions on 'Antidote' and the usageLabel shows combined count — correct per spec. Details array uses string push ('dictionnaires'/'guides') which is clean.

SurveillanceReport renders one `report-tools` div per student; since multiple same-testid elements exist (9 in this test), querySelectorAll is required. Confirmed as spec-expected ('data-testid report-tools per student').

Results.jsx hidden report container uses `-left-[9999px]` to offscreen it for html2pdf; this works but creates 9 inline SurveillanceReport entries always mounted — minor perf concern for large classes (hundreds of sessions) but acceptable for MVP.

RichEditor only renders dict/guide buttons when antidoteApiAvailable() returns true at render time; it is not reactive to window.monExam being set later. In practice window.monExam is injected by the desktop host before React boots, so this is fine.
seed_data_creation: Student sessions on HIS301: 'TEST DictGuide Iter13' (has antidote_dict, antidote_guide, antidote_correct events) and 'TEST NoMock Iter13' (no tool events). Safe to leave for future retests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testids: exam-rich-editor-antidote-dict-btn / exam-rich-editor-antidote-guide-btn / exam-rich-editor-antidote-btn. Dict/Guide render only when window.monExam.antidotePort exists. Teacher SessionDetail shows a 'tool-usage' card (toolUsage() from events) with Antidote utilisations and labels 'dictionnaires', 'guides', 'correcteur'. Surveillance PDF button is export-surveillance-report-btn on Results page; it renders 9 copies of SurveillanceReport inside a hidden container with one 'report-tools' testid per student. The server-side `GET /api/exams/{id}/sessions` properly includes antidote_dict/antidote_guide events (verified indirectly via the tool-usage card content).
rca of the issue: N/A - all 5 scenarios in the review request verified working as expected.
